books.title: Treasure Island
books.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
books.description: Young Jim Hawkins finds a treasure map and sails with the cunning Long John Silver in search of buried pirate gold.

books.title: Around the World in Eighty Days
books.author: Jules Verne
books.description: Phileas Fogg wagers his fortune that he can circle the globe in eighty days, with his valet Passepartout at his side.

books.title: The Kite Runner
books.author: Khaled Hosseini
books.description: A story of friendship, betrayal and redemption between two boys growing up in Kabul.

books.title: Normal People
books.author: Sally Rooney
books.description: Connell and Marianne drift together and apart through school and university in small-town Ireland and Dublin.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.author: Jane Austen
books.description: Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy overcome pride, prejudice and their families on the way to love.

books.title: Jane Eyre
books.author: Charlotte Brontë
books.description: An orphaned governess falls for her brooding employer, Mr. Rochester, at mysterious Thornfield Hall.

books.title: The Hobbit
books.author: J. R. R. Tolkien
books.description: Bilbo Baggins is swept into a quest with thirteen dwarves to reclaim their treasure from the dragon Smaug.

books.title: A Wizard of Earthsea
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.description: A gifted young wizard, Ged, unleashes a shadow upon the world and must hunt it down.

books.title: Nineteen Eighty-Four
books.author: George Orwell
books.description: Winston Smith quietly rebels against Big Brother in a totalitarian state that controls every thought.

books.title: The Handmaid's Tale
books.author: Margaret Atwood
books.description: In the theocratic Republic of Gilead, Offred is forced to bear children for the ruling class.

books.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
books.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
books.description: Sherlock Holmes investigates a legendary spectral hound haunting the Baskerville family on Dartmoor.

books.title: The Name of the Rose
books.author: Umberto Eco
books.description: A Franciscan friar investigates a series of deaths in a remote 14th-century Italian abbey.
